prompt:
The section file sections/video-feature-embed.liquid embeds a YouTube or Vimeo video. The markup is correct: it treats a null or blank section.settings.video_url as "no video" and then falls back to section.settings.cover, hides the heading and caption when they are blank, and falls back to the title 'Video' when section.settings.video_title is blank. The {% schema %} block is wrong. Do NOT change the markup. Replace only the JSON inside the single {% schema %}...{% endschema %} block so that it is exactly the following. Key order inside objects does not matter. Array order DOES matter. Do not add any keys that are not listed.

Top-level keys:
- "name": "Video feature"
- "tag": "section"
- "class": "video-feature-section"
- "disabled_on": {"groups": ["header", "footer"]}
- "settings": array, in this order:
  1. {type "text", id "heading", label "Heading"}. It has NO default key (not even an empty string), so a new section starts with no heading.
  2. {type "video_url", id "video_url", label "Video URL", accept ["youtube", "vimeo"] in that order}. It has no default.
  3. {type "text", id "video_title", label "Video title", default "Watch the video"}
  4. {type "image_picker", id "cover", label "Fallback cover image"}
  5. {type "checkbox", id "autoplay", label "Autoplay muted", default false (boolean)}
  6. {type "select", id "aspect_ratio", label "Aspect ratio", options in this order: {value "widescreen", label "16:9"}, {value "standard", label "4:3"}, {value "square", label "1:1"}; default "widescreen" (the option value, not its label)}
  7. {type "richtext", id "caption", label "Caption"}. It has no default.
- "presets": exactly one preset: {name "Video feature"} with no other keys.
- There is no "blocks" key and no "max_blocks" key.

The file must still contain exactly one schema block, placed after the markup, and it must pass Theme Check. Change only sections/video-feature-embed.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
